item.title: 【HD Live Performances】WEB-RiP - Girls' Generation (SNSD) - The 1st Japan Tour 1440p
item.description:
"The 1st Japan Arena Tour" is the first Japanese concert tour by Girls' Generation to promote their 2011 self-titled album in Japanese.

This is a RIP from an upscale available on YouTube – which was not done by me. All credits to the channel that uploaded and did the upscale: Light_x02. I will try to upload the uncompressed files to a private server soon.

For now, due to the size and the servers she made available, the file will be in 1440p with YouTube's compression. But, for those who want it, the original uncompressed link will be available.
